title: September worker's schedule — Financial Stewardship
body: This month's theme is Financial Stewardship. Communion assistants: Sis. Laidz Pascual and Bro. Allen Santos on Fridays; Bro. Wilson Guerzon and Ptr. Nerwin Suelo on Sundays. Friday 25 September is led by the Women's & Men's Fellowship. Sunday 27 September: Sis. Grace Siangco presides, Bro. Edmund Gabriel leads songs, Sis. Fretz Guerzon preaches, Sis. Laidz Pascual leads the pastoral prayer, and the Flores family has the food.

title: Small groups are being re-formed by area
body: Groups are being rearranged so that nobody travels more than half an hour on a work night. If you have moved accommodation this year, tell your group leader so you are placed near where you now live rather than where you used to.

title: Help for members between contracts
body: The benevolence fund exists for members who have lost work, are waiting on a transfer, or have an emergency at home. Requests are handled by two deacons and are not discussed anywhere else. Asking is not a failure, and it is not a debt.

title: We need two more people on the welcome team
body: One Friday a month, arriving forty minutes early. It is the least visible job in the church and the first thing a newcomer experiences. Training is one conversation, not a course.

title: A word about giving while supporting a family at home
body: Several members have asked whether they should give when money is already going home every month. The short answer: give something, plan it rather than deciding at the door, and never borrow to give. Anyone who wants to talk it through can ask for an appointment.
